title: Long-term study of venglustat in adults and children with gaucher disease type 3 or fabry disease who previously completed a venglustat study
official: Phase 3, open-label, long term extension basket study of Venglustat in adult and pediatric patients with Gaucher type 3 disease and adult patients with Fabry disease, who previously completed Venglustat Phase 2 or Phase 3 studies
summary: Main objective: To characterize the long-term safety and tolerability of venglustat over extended treatment exposure period in participants with GD3 and FD
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participants are eligible to be included in the study only if all of the following criteria apply:  • Adult or pediatric participants with GD3 or adult participants with FD who have previously completed one of the following venglustat parent studies: LEAP2MONO (EFC17215), LEAP (PDY13949), PERIDOT (EFC17045), or CARAT (EFC16158).
2. Participants are eligible to be included in the study only if all of the following criteria apply:  • Adult and Pediatric participants:  - Adult participant is ≥18 years of age.  - Pediatric participant is ≥12 years to <18 years of age.
3. The participant with GD3 is deemed clinically stable at screening by the Investigator (participant may continue to receive rescue treatment initiated in the parent study).
4. Contraceptive use by both male and female participants should be consistent with local regulations regarding the methods of contraception for those participating in clinical studies. Not pregnant or breastfeeding; no sperm  donating for male participant.
5. A signed informed consent must be provided prior to any study-related procedures. In countries where legal age of majority is above 18 years, a specific ICF must also be signed by the participant’s legally authorized  representative (LAR).
6. Eligibility is limited to individuals who meet the age-related provisions defined under the informed consent and assent requirements, as applicable.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Any clinically significant disease, other than GD3 or FD, that in the opinion of the Investigator may interfere with participation in the study
2. Severe depression as measured by Beck’s Depression Inventory (BDI)-II score >28 at screening and/or a history of a major affective disorder within one year of screening examination.
3. Participants with current suicidal ideation (Statement 2 or 3 for Question 9 of BDI-II questionnaire) at screening.
4. Estimated glomerular filtration rate <30 mL/min/1.73 m2 at the screening visit.
5. Liver enzymes (alanine aminotransferase, aspartate aminotransferase) or total bilirubin >2 times the upper limit of normal.
6. Use of strong or moderate inducers or inhibitors of cytochrome P450(CYP)3A within 14 days or 5 half-lives,  whichever is longer, prior to randomization. This also includes the consumption of grapefruit, grapefruit juice, or  grapefruit containing products within 72 hours of starting IMP administration.
7. Prior gene therapy or exposure to any investigational drug other than venglustat within the last 30 days or 5 half- lives from screening, whichever is longer
8. The participant, in the opinion of the Investigator, is unable to adhere to the requirements of the study or unable to undergo study assessments (eg, contraindication for MRI).
9. Sensitivity to any of the study interventions, or components thereof, or drug.
